intro: One channel, damage almost everywhere. VDAC1 sits where energy, calcium and cell-death decisions meet, so when it misfires, different organs pay the price. Tap a glowing spot for the disease link and the paper I'd start with.
panelHint: Tap or hover a glowing spot
panelBlurb: Each hotspot ties VDAC1 to a specific disease, with the one paper worth your time.
listSub: Prefer a list? Same map, organ, the VDAC1 connection, and the paper to read.

regions.label: Brain
regions.blurb: Neurons burn the most energy, so they feel VDAC1 failure first. The channel links to amyloid and tau, and to the PSEN1 calcium pathways behind familial Alzheimer's.

regions.label: Eye
regions.blurb: In the commonest adult eye cancer, VDAC1 turned up as a genome-stability gene, switch it off and tumour cells die, but their DNA unravels.

regions.label: Heart
regions.blurb: VDAC1 anchors the ER–mitochondria contact points that meter calcium into heart cells. Those contacts break down after a heart attack.

regions.label: Lungs
regions.blurb: Fibroblasts that can't recycle damaged mitochondria drive lung scarring. Restart mitophagy (PINK1/Parkin) and the scarring eases.

regions.label: Immune / spleen
regions.blurb: VDAC1 oligomers leak mtDNA that trips the cGAS–STING alarm. VBIT-12 calmed T-cell inflammation; the VBIT-4 lupus paper kicked off the whole field.

regions.label: Liver
regions.blurb: The same mtDNA-leak-then-inflammation loop shows up in fatty liver disease, and VBIT-4 has been tried against it in models.

regions.label: Kidneys
regions.blurb: Human genetics points to mitochondrial genes as causes of kidney failure, and blocking VDAC1 oligomerization has protected kidneys in models.

regions.label: Bladder
regions.blurb: Tumour cells tag VDAC1 for mitophagy to survive cisplatin. Close that escape hatch and the chemo works again.
regions.paperLabel: Zhang et al., Drug Resist Updat 2026

regions.label: Joints
regions.blurb: Cartilage cells with failing mitochondria leak mtDNA and inflame the joint. A mitochondria-targeting nanozyme restarts mitophagy and quiets it.
